QuestInfo.2: There was very little on your past in the files, only that you were from Edelstein and your memories were erased several times. It's doubtful you'll find anything else here...

0.0: Maybe we can put it back together and figure out what it is.

yes.0: Okay, let me organize what's left. Talk to me in a bit.

no.0: I suppose you're not in the mood to find out right now. Just let me know if you want to give it a go.

1.1: Just a bunch of test results. They're just meaningless numbers.\r\n#L0##bSo there's nothing about my past?#l\n#k
1.2: All I could make out was #bEdelstein#k, #bCandidate#k, and...\r\n#L0##bAnd what?#l\n#k
1.3: Critical error, Obstacle Removed... I bet Gelimer thought our memories interfered with our obedience, but he couldn't erase them all. He must have tried to overwrite yours with his soldier programming. From the looks of it, over, and over... \r\n#L0##bDoes that mean my memories are gone forever?#l\n#k
1.4: You managed to remember some of your past already, right? There must still be traces of your emotions and memories within you. #bThey can't completely be gone#k.\r\n

yes.0: The rest of this stuff is just stupid test results. Let's get back to Veritas and show these to the Professor.
